notes.title: Minor UI Fixes.
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Updated button navigation on several menus to be more intuitive with a controller. (Setup menu, unit selection, item storage.)
- Fixed an issue where you could select off screen ui elements on the item menu with a controller.
- Updated options menu so you can interact with the volume sliders with a controller.
- Updated options menu so you can interact with the speed settings with a controller.

notes.title: Minor Fixes.
notes.content:
Changelog:

Fixed some missing sound effects.
Added new tutorial slide for calcuating combat damage
Updated tutorial images to a better aspect ratio
Fixed grammar errors in some tutorial slides.

notes.title: Small Update 25/3/21
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- Fixed a bug where Gavan would not load correctly on mission 5.
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't use the arrow keys to select targets.
- Fixed an issue where AI Rider units would sometimes move to the square of another unit that hadn't moved yet.
- Renamed "End Turn" (single unit) to "Wait" to make it distinct from "End Turn" (all units).
- Updated some text that wasn't going through the localisation system.
- Added Controller support.

notes.title: Easy Balance Update
notes.content: Reduced all stats of enemy units by 1 for missions 1-7.
